en.title: Version 1.1.0
en.content:
**Navigation**
- Replace icon-only header links with visible text and category dropdowns across the application and public landing page.
- Group meters, batteries and statistics under Tracking; tariffs, advances and bill reconciliation under Budget; Discord, GitHub and project support under Project; and profile, authorized admin access and secure sign-out under My account.
- Keep the dashboard and meter-reading entry directly accessible. Public visitors see statistics and sign-in instead of private navigation.
- Show compact dropdown panels with descriptions on desktop and category accordions in the mobile menu. Keep current pages and their categories highlighted.

**Accessibility and preferences**
- Keep the language selector, dark-theme switch and account menu available when mobile navigation is collapsed. Display the current language by its native name and preserve page state when changing language.
- Add French, English, German and Dutch category labels and descriptions. Expose the dark-theme switch state to assistive technology while honoring system preferences and stored choices. Keep manual switching and system-theme updates working when browser storage is unavailable.
- Support one open header menu at a time, outside-click dismissal, Escape with focus restoration, keyboard activation, reduced motion and responsive focus transfer.
- Preserve native menu operation when JavaScript is unavailable, logout POST/CSRF protection and configurable optional external links.

**Tests and shared templates**
- Share category rendering and primary navigation between application and public headers.
- Add rendering regressions for category destinations and active state, persistent controls, translations, public/admin access, logout security and external links.
